why: We already captured cold-start default values. The remaining parameter-schema gap is Windows-side range metadata: hard min/max, whether AE exposes bounds, and popup/count shape.
This request is for parameter-definition evidence rather than algorithm output. The main artifact is the manifest/property metadata, not the PNG.
Having Windows-grounded range metadata will let the Mac port stop guessing slider ranges or popup defaults when AE UI behavior matters.

inputs.description: Use a simple opaque 1920x1080 source layer. Pixels are secondary; metadata is primary.

instructions: For each case, create a fresh comp and a fresh source layer.
Add exactly one OLM effect to the selected layer.
Do not edit any OLM parameter after adding the effect.
Immediately record the full selected effect property tree.
For every readable property, also record range metadata where AE scripting exposes it: hasMin, hasMax, minValue, maxValue, unitsText, and any popup/enum count or choice labels if available.
If a given metadata field is not accessible from the Windows AE script API, write null or omit it and record a short limitation note rather than guessing.
Save before_effects_frame and effect output PNGs only as supporting artifacts; metadata is the priority.

cases.reason: Capture slider/popup range metadata for Blur Amount, Blur Smoothness, Repeat, Bias Direction, and Legacy.
Capture range metadata for thresholds, edge controls, color count, popup fields, and grouped controls.
Capture range metadata for front/back strength, alpha fade, sharp tail, noise, thickness, and popups.
Capture threshold, power, blur size, and popup range metadata for the Windows AEX.
Capture length, opacity, brightness, strength, and popup range metadata for all ray controls.
Capture range metadata for outer/inner controls, ratio, angle, quality, brightness, noise, and layer selectors.
Capture v1 tolerance and color-key range metadata.
Capture v2 smoothness, extra smooth, range, gamma, and popup metadata.
Capture search-radius range metadata and any built-in AE side properties.

manifest_requirements: Record all selected effect property names, match_names, property_index, property_type, property_value_type, enabled/active state, and values where readable.
For each readable property, also record AE scripting range/bounds metadata where available: hasMin, hasMax, minValue, maxValue, unitsText, and popup choice information if available.
Record hidden/group/no-value properties too; if bounds are not readable for those, record the limitation rather than guessing.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
Treat this as a fresh-instance range capture: no manual edits after the effect is added.
mac_follow_up: Use the returned manifest as the Windows source of truth for fresh-instance bounds/range metadata.
Diff the returned bounds against refs/reports/mac_plugin_param_schema_20260629.json before changing Mac UI ranges.
